Name: Rechab, Son of Rimmon
Summary: Rechab, son of Rimmon the Beerothite and a captain of Ish-bosheth's bands, murdered Ish-bosheth in his bed at noon and carried his head to David, expecting reward. David had him and his brother executed for killing a righteous man in his own house.
KeyStory: Rechab murdered his own king for a reward and was executed for it the same day.
RelatedPeople: Ish-bosheth, Son of Saul; Baanah, Son of Rimmon; King David
LifeLesson: Murder offered as a gift is still murder, and a just king refuses the price.
